typography.instruction: Keep all text live; do not rasterise headings or controls.

implementation.icons: Use transparent PNG assets at intrinsic aspect ratio.
implementation.cards: Recreate with CSS using white surfaces, subtle grey borders, soft shadows and rounded corners.
implementation.buttons: Recreate with deep-purple fills, warm-gold outlines and gold arrow icons.
implementation.progressRings: Prefer CSS/SVG for dynamic values; supplied PNG rings are exact visual references.
